newsitem.title: USA: Hart Re to buy Orion reinsurance renewal rights.
newsitem.headline: Hart Re to buy Orion reinsurance renewal rights.

text.p: ITT Hartford Group Inc. said Thursday its reinsurance operation, Hartford Re Co., agreed to acquire the ongoing business of SecurityRe Companies, Orion Capital's reinsurance unit.
The deal came less than two weeks after ITT Hartford concluded the purchase of renewal rights to San Francisco Re's reinsurance business.
ITT Hartford said that with both deals, its reinsurance business expected to assume more than $150 million of additional annual reinsurance premiums.
Hartford Re Co. is the nation's 11th-biggest reinsurer, with $522 million in net written premiums last year.
HartRe will start renewing SecurityRe's reinsurance contracts beginning Nov. 14.
"It makes both companies better off," said Gary Ransom, an analyst at Conning & Co. in Hartford. "It purifies what Orion is doing, and it helps build up one of The Hartford's important segments."

The deal was not a surprise, said Ransom. "Security Re was an operation that didn't completely fit with Orion. It was a small reinsurance company -- and the market isn't going the way of the small reinsurance company. It's going the way of the large reinsurance company."
Reinsurance should represent about 10 percent of The Hartford's projected $5.8 billion in property and casualty operations in calendar 1996, Ransom said.
ITT Hartford's shares fell 12.5 cents to $66.625, while Orion Capital was unchanged at $61.50 on the New York Stock Exchange in late trading.
